unknowns.text: OM-E04 says every event body has of: {role: ref@n}. A session event (CT-P01) records a participant and is about nothing. May of be an empty object, so that the session event is an event like any other? The alternative is a named exemption of the session type in the kernel.
unknowns.resolution: of may be an empty object: the kernel requires the member of on every event body (an object whose values are references) and no role in it; the session event of CT-P01 has of = {}. No type is exempted by the kernel. The maintainer's answer in the spec-PR replaces this assumption.
